description:
You are the security manager at BuildingTech Solutions. A quarterly contractor review has determined that all contracts with Meridian Facilities have been terminated effective immediately. Per company security policy, you must offboard every user associated with Meridian Facilities from the access control system:

1. Disable every user account whose company is 'Meridian Facilities' (accounts must be set to disabled — do NOT delete them, as records must be retained for audit).
2. Revoke ALL access credentials (RFID cards and PINs) from each Meridian Facilities user.

You are NOT provided a list of affected employees — you must identify them yourself by inspecting the system. Only Meridian Facilities users should be touched; do not modify any other users.

Log in at https://localhost:9443 as admin (password: 2n).
